g.text: Café 1300 is located on the ground floor of the
Main Hospital. Visitors and guests can enjoy
a variety of food and beverage selections.
Express Grill Station: Open all day
Eyes of Texas Café is located on the ground
floor of the M.T. Mustian Center.
The Main Hospital Gift Shop is located on
the ground floor of the hospital, near Elevator C.
It is stocked with gifts, flower arrangements,
The Women’s Pavilion Gift Shop is located just
outside of Elevator K near the entrance to the
Family Care Unit on the third floor of the Women’s
Pavilion. It is stocked with mom and baby gifts,
fresh coffee, food, drinks and snacks.
Tallahassee Memorial HealthCare (TMH) is the leading healthcare system in the region serving 21 counties
in North Florida, South Georgia and South Alabama.
With 772 beds, over 5,500 employees and more than 1,000 medical staff members, TMH is one of the largest
hospitals in the state of Florida. TMH is a private, not-for-profit healthcare system with a vision to be known as
the most engaged and supportive organization in the country.
